title: Restrictions of the dot action representation
summary: Regular semisimple Hessenberg varieties are subvarieties of flag varieties defined for any reductive group. Their cohomology carries a representation of the associated Weyl group, known as the dot action representation. In type $A$, these representations can be computed using the chromatic quasisymmetric functions of naturally labeled unit interval graphs. We prove that restricting the dot action representation of any Weyl group to a type $A$ parabolic subgroup yields a representation isomorphic to a direct sum of type $A$ dot action representations.
